We propose DualRAG, a dual-process RAG framework that tightly integrates Reasoning-augmented Querying (RaQ) and progressive Knowledge Aggregation (pKA) to address multi-hop QA problems. RaQ dynamically identifies knowledge demands and formulates targeted retrieval queries, while pKA structures and refines acquired information to support coherent reasoning.
